subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: Should this remain a broad browser/search hardening umbrella, or should maintainers split it into specific search-provider bugs, Lightpanda/browser-backend evaluation, and benchmark-matrix work?
rationale: The source shows only partial current coverage, while the remaining work changes product scope, public config/API shape, and security boundaries that automation should not choose.

options.title: Scope and split first
options.body: Keep this open for maintainer scoping, then move each approved slice into a narrow issue with acceptance criteria and security requirements.

options.title: Route to existing browser issues
options.body: Make the open browser-backed access and external CDP/noVNC issues canonical for their parts, then keep only the benchmark/search-hardening remainder here.

options.title: Defer Lightpanda
options.body: Close or narrow the Lightpanda portion until there is a maintainer-approved browser backend or plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Scope and split first
recommendation.body: Keep this open for maintainer scoping, then move each approved slice into a narrow issue with acceptance criteria and security requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history spans sandbox browser, SearXNG hardening, and browser/search security boundaries.
